money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is the Albanian Lek (ALL). You must declare if you're carrying amounts equivalent to $US 20,000 when you arrive or leave. This covers all forms of currency, not only cash. ATMs and credit card facilities are available in larger cities and in tourist areas. Many shops and service providers prefer cash. You can change major currencies at banks and authorised exchange bureaus. Credit card fraud can happen. Take care not to expose your PIN. Check your bank statements often.

laws.rule: To drive in Albania, you need both: an International Driving Permit (IDP) a current Australian driver's licence (digital driver’s licences may not be accepted) Get your IDP before leaving Australia.

laws.rule: Albania applies the EU drone rules since July 2022 to all drones whatever their use or size. Fly no higher than 120 m, keep the drone in sight, and stay out of restricted areas such as near airports without permission. AAC says only Albanian residents and businesses based in Albania can register as drone operators. Minimum age 16.

drone-pilot-pathway.summary: Albania applies the EU drone rules (since July 2022). The Civil Aviation Authority says only Albanian residents and businesses based in Albania can register as operators. No public operator register was found.

items.text: No public register of drone operators was found on the AAC drone page.

Operations outside the Open category are Specific and need prior AAC authorisation with a risk assessment (SORA) or a declared standard scenario, and the operator must be registered with an operator ID. Certified-category work (passengers, dangerous goods) is described as not yet active for the public. AAC fees apply (Joint Instruction 11 of 24 December 2024).

Quoting Article 14 of the UAS Regulation, AAC says operators register in Albania where they live (individuals) or have their main place of business (companies), and cannot be registered in more than one state at once; it reads this as meaning only Albanian residents and businesses may register as operators. The page does not set out a visitor route.
